summary: Iteration 3 – validated the MOBILE ADMIN MENU BUG FIX and ALL new iteration-3 features (tariffs CRUD, installations, portabilities, resources, settings/email guard, eSIM QR, SIM/line admin actions, subscription optionals + change titular, customer documents, coverage address, order tracking email guard). Backend: 22 new tests + 1 skip (skip was worker race, sequential run confirms PASS) — combined with iter1+iter2, 58/58 pytest passing. Frontend: mobile menu bug FIXED (hamburger visible on 390x844, sheet opens with all 12 nav items + logout, closes on nav click, desktop sidebar has display:none on mobile); tariffs full CRUD; line detail shows esim-card + line-actions-card with all 4 admin buttons; SPN action end-to-end verified; client portal renders 2 lines correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1200 lines and continues to host models, helpers, seeding AND all routers. Split into routers/ (customers, lines, tariffs, subscriptions, installations, portabilities, resources, docs, payments, email) and services/ to keep the file under 500 lines.

customer_documents: content is stored as base64 inside MongoDB — fine for demo, but for real customers should be moved to blob storage (S3 / Likes uploadURL). Also, there is no download endpoint (uploaded docs cannot be retrieved), only list.
documents endpoints do not enforce a max size — a rogue upload could bloat Mongo. Add server-side size limit (e.g. 5 MB) and reject non-whitelisted MIME types.
GET /api/customers/{fiscalId}/documents is admin-only; the client portal has no read-access to their own docs — inconsistent with rest of endpoints which are scoped per fiscalId.
POST /installations/{id}/appointment accepts an unvalidated `dict` — replace with a Pydantic model {date:str,slot:str} to prevent malformed data being persisted.
emailer.send_email raises RuntimeError when API key missing but callers already check emailer.is_configured() first — dead-code branch, could be simplified.
likes_client.CONNECTION_STATE is a module-level mutable dict shared across requests. In a multi-worker deployment this becomes per-worker; acceptable for demo but note for production.
resources download always returns the same CSV regardless of `path` — mock is fine, but log a debug line saying 'MOCK content served' so operators are not misled once the real API is enabled.
AdminLayout mobile Sheet uses onNavigate to close, but user-triggered browser back/forward inside the sheet does not close it — acceptable, but consider `location.pathname` effect to auto-close.
Settings page: `send-test-email-btn` is properly disabled and shows 'Falta API key' banner — good UX. Consider disabling the input as well to make the state obvious.

Tariffs.js: after create/edit/delete the client refetches via `load()` which is fine, but the state briefly shows stale prices if the request is slow — a spinner or optimistic update would improve UX.
LinePanel.js Row helper is duplicated across LinePanel, Settings, and admin CustomerDetail — extract to a shared component.
